d.title: Kawarazaki-ke no Ichizoku The Animation
d.jp: 河原崎家の一族 THE ANIMATION
d.synopsis: The days at a hostal doesn't seem to be very normal. Instead the visitors get a special treatement. The maids are always on dispose to serve their masters even if it is something not really normal. Hiden room and double view mirrors are only a part of this ex-state building.
